text:
maya: Customer attached a 28s screen recording of the app hitting 500s. Ticket has no req id or logs. Any quick, low-friction ask we can send the customer?

alex: If the recording shows the browser devtools network pane ask them to pause on the failing request and screenshot the Response Headers. We only need `x-request-id` (sometimes `x-redwood-request-id`). They can also right-click -> Copy -> Copy as cURL and paste that here.

sam: Pasteable steps for non-engineers (short):
- Open devtools -> Network
- Reproduce the error
- Pause the video when the failing row is visible
- Right click -> Copy -> Copy as cURL OR take a screenshot of the Headers tab
- Send the cURL OR screenshot here

maya: Mobile WebView notes: ask them to enable remote debugging (Chrome on Android) or connect the iOS device to a Mac and use Safari Web Inspector. If they can't do remote debug, ask them to pause the video where the request URL is visible (we can sometimes correlate URL path + timestamp).

alex: If they have no devtools access, ask for a copyable curl we can replay. Minimal curl template they can fill in (replace tokens):

```
curl 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/endpoint' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-request-id: <FROM_HEADERS_IF_AVAILABLE>' \
  --data-raw '{"input":"..."}' \
  -v
```

sam: SDK / device logs: ask for a 30s log window around the failure. Our SDKs include `req_id` / `request_id` in logs. Quick grep examples they can run (or paste output):
- Android: `adb logcat -d | grep -i request_id`
- iOS/sysdiagnose snippet: `log show --predicate 'eventMessage contains "request_id"' --last 1h`

maya: If the only artifact is a video and we truly can't see headers: ask for the exact wall-clock timestamp (UTC) shown in the video + the user/session identifier. We can search proxy logs for requests in +/-30s and match by path + user-agent.

deploy-bot: DEBUG TOKEN created: https://console.redwood.com/debug/abcdef1234 (expires in 24h) :wrench:

alex: Short copy to paste to customer: 
1) If possible: Copy-as-cURL from network tab and paste it here.
2) Else: Screenshot of Response Headers showing `x-request-id`.
3) Else: Exact UTC timestamp of the failure + user/session anchor.
4) Else: 30s of SDK/device logs around the failure.

maya: I'll send that to the customer now. Thanks!
